08d_1_rescaling_factors.png: Left, on a logarithmic axis, against $z = 6Hx_0$ across one cell from the tip near 0 through the fold ($\pi/2$, gray line) to the tip near $\pi$, at one time: the factor $(\sin^2 z)^{-1/8}$ (solid) of the rescaling $\Psi = e^{a_4/2}b_4^{-1}(\sin^2 z)^{-1/8}\chi$, which removes the term $c_g\gamma^{(0)} + v_g\gamma^{(4)}$, and the factor $|\sin z|^{-1/2}$ (dashed) of the new coupling $\lambda e^{a_4}S_\chi/(b_4^2|\sin z|^{1/2})$; both equal 1 at the fold and diverge at the tips, the same on both halves. Right: the hidden coordinate $y = \ln|\sin z|/(6H)$ for $H = 1$, in which the norm of $\Psi$ is $\int\chi^\dagger\chi\,|dy|$, against $z$ on a logarithmic axis; $y = 0$ at the fold and $y \to -\infty$ at the tip. Dotted: the cutoff $y = -L = -3$ of the Kohn-Sham record, reached only at $z = \arcsin(e^{-18}) \approx 1.5 \times 10^{-8}$ (black dot).
08d_2_family_k_squared.png: Left: the coefficient $\mu_A = \frac32H(4\alpha + 1)e^{Hx_4/3}$ of the reduced equation $\Phi' = (-m\gamma^{(4)} + \mu_AK)\Phi$ along the history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ ($H = 1$) for the exponents $\alpha = 0, 0.5, 1$, against the time $x_4$, on a logarithmic axis; where it crosses the gray line of a mass $m$, the instantaneous rate $\sqrt{\mu_A^2 - m^2}$ becomes real and the member starts to grow, so every mass is overtaken after a finite time. Right: the base-10 logarithm of the growth factor $e^{I}$, $I = \frac92(4\alpha + 1)(e^{x_4/3} - 1)$, of the exact massless members (i-a), on a logarithmic axis: the curves approach straight lines, so the growth factor is a double exponential, faster than any exponential (gray: the exponential $e^{x_4}$, whose curve bends down).
08d_3_growing_finite_norm.png: The plane of the mass $m$ (horizontal, units of $H$) and the exponent $\alpha$ (vertical) of the members $e^{a_4/2}b_4^{-1}(\sin^2 z)^{\alpha/2}\Phi(x_4)$, coloured by the time at which their instantaneous growth rate becomes real on the history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ ($H = 1$), $x_4 = 3\ln(2m/(3|4\alpha + 1|))$, clipped to the range from $-6$ to $9$. Left of the white curve the member grows already at $x_4 = 0$. Hatched: $\alpha < -1/4$, infinite norm at the tip; on the black line $\alpha = -1/4$ the member never grows. Red: the $x_0$-independent modes ($\alpha = 0$). Every member with a finite norm starts to grow after a finite time, for every mass.
08d_4_patch_end_modes.png: Left: the eigenvalues $\pm\sqrt{m^2 - c_g^2}$ of the matrix $A = -im\gamma^{(4)} + ic_g\gamma^{(4)}\gamma^{(0)}$, which acts on the $x_0$-independent fields of the good sector, in the complex plane for $m = 2$, $H = 1$, coloured by the time $x_4$ from $-2$ to $3$ along the history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$, on which $c_g = \frac32e^{x_4/3}$. While $c_g < m$ they lie on the real axis (oscillation); they meet at 0 at $x_4 = 3\ln(4/3) \approx 0.863$ and then lie on the imaginary axis (a mode $e^{-iEx_4}$ grows). Right: the instantaneous growth rate $\sqrt{c_g^2 - m^2}$ against $x_4$ for $m = 0.5, 1, 2, 4$; the light masses grow already at $x_4 = 0$, and every curve leaves zero after a finite time.
08d_5_norm_and_flux.png: An $x_0$-independent mode of the good sector, $\Psi = e^{a_4/2}b_4^{-1}\chi(x_4)$ with $m = 2$, $H = 1$, along the history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ from a fixed random start, solved with RK4, against the time $x_4$ in units of $1/H$. Left, on a logarithmic axis: its norm $N = \int\sqrt{|g|}\,\Psi^\dagger\Psi\,dx_0$ over the first half of a cell, which wavers while $c_g < m$ and grows faster and faster after the onset at $x_4 = 3\ln(4/3)$ (dotted). Right, on an axis that is linear between $-1$ and $1$ and logarithmic outside: the rate of change $dN/dx_4$ (line) and the flux $b_4^{3/2}\Psi^\dagger\gamma^{(4)}\gamma^{(0)}\Psi$ through the fold $z = \pi/2$ (dots); they coincide at every time: the norm changes only through the fold, where the Revision record imposes no boundary condition.
